sections.headline: AI features with one defined job.
sections.lead: In these projects AI takes on one task inside a product: evaluating survey answers, helping visitors act on a website, remembering what agents learn. I help find that task in your product and build it in.

sections.heading: Where AI already works in my projects

items.fit: AI-assisted survey creation, translation and evaluation; the owner estimates more than 50% less time for creation and evaluation.
An embeddable assistant that answers, navigates and helps fill forms, with approval before anything is submitted.
Agent memory that combines graph and vector storage with LLM-assisted memorisation and retrieval.

sections.heading: What could your product do with AI?
sections.text: Start with your product and the people using it. You don’t need a feature specification.
